title: 2014 AMC 12A Problem 25
statement: The parabola \(P\) has focus \((0,0)\) and goes through the points \((4,3)\) and \((-4,-3).\) For how many points \((x,y)\in P\) with integer coordinates is it true that \(|4x+3y|\le1000?\)

solutions.text:
Since \((0,0)\) is the midpoint of \(A=(4,3)\) and \(B=(-4,-3),\) the segment \(AB\) is the latus rectum, so the directrix is parallel to \(AB\) at distance \(5\) on the far side, namely \(4y-3x+25=0.\)

Equating distances to focus and directrix gives \((4x+3y)^2\) \(=25\big(25+2(4y-3x)\big).\) Writing \(4x+3y=5s\) forces \(s\) to be a multiple of \(5,\) and \(s=5t\) forces \(t\) odd; with \(t=2u+1\) the integer points are \[ \begin{aligned} x&=-6u^2+2u+4,\\ y&=8u^2+14u+3. \end{aligned} \]

Then \(|4x+3y|=|50u+25|\le1000\) iff \(|2u+1|\le39,\) i.e. \(-20\le u\le19.\) That gives \(40\) lattice points.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: \((0,0)\) is the midpoint of \((4,3)\) and \((-4,-3),\) so this chord is the latus rectum and the directrix is parallel to it
The directrix is \(4y-3x+25=0\); parametrize the lattice points and reduce \(|4x+3y|\) to \(|50u+25|\le1000\)
